note: The one validator registry. scripts/validate_all.js runs exactly this list and fails if it is empty or a listed file is missing.

validators.name: validate_dental_compliance.js
validators.protects: no dental claims go public: guarantees, best/top dentist, pain-free/painless, before/after promises, cures, visible third-party practice branding; resources keep the educational disclaimer and exam boundary
validators.why: owner ruling 1 Nov 2026 (no claims; dental industry bounds) and health-advertising risk

validators.name: validate_no_phi_forms.js
validators.protects: no page collects patient health information (no textarea, file upload or symptom/insurance form)
validators.why: static site must never collect PHI

validators.name: validate_admin_gate.js
validators.protects: admin paths (/admin, /data/admin, admin.js) answer 401 without a server session; 503 when the secrets are missing; wrong passwords lock out; the right one opens
validators.why: owner, 3 Nov 2026: /admin/ must not be open

validators.name: validate_admin_protection.js
validators.protects: admin JS ships no password, password hash or secret-like strings (a client-side gate is not protection)
validators.why: public repo; admin JS ships to every visitor

validators.name: validate_booking_links.js
validators.protects: every external link is an approved booking page or a known host; question pages may cite sources but any booking/scheduling link must be the approved one
validators.why: patients must only be sent to the practice's real booking page

validators.name: validate_approval_gate.js
validators.protects: content not yet due never renders publicly; due content does; previews and admin stay noindex
validators.why: scheduled release: drafts and future items must not leak

validators.name: validate_sitemap.js
validators.protects: sitemap lists every public resource and question page, never admin, previews or not-yet-due items; robots disallows admin and previews
validators.why: what is public and indexable must match what is released

validators.name: validate_admin_manifest.js
validators.protects: admin manifest is generated with every item, its preview path and a real GitHub edit link
validators.why: admin dashboard reads this file; a broken manifest silently empties it

validators.name: validate_resource_sources.js
validators.protects: each dental resource carries at least two complete source records
validators.why: health content must be sourced, never invented

validators.name: validate_site_config.js
validators.protects: site config points at the real domain and repo; no OWNER/example.com placeholders reach the sitemap, robots or manifest
validators.why: a placeholder domain would canonicalise the site away

validators.name: validate_head_and_schema.js
validators.protects: every published page carries a unique 30-65 character title, exactly one 120-160 character meta description, complete og tags with an og:image on our own host, an Organization with logo and sameAs as the first one a reader meets, WebPage + BreadcrumbList, and a LocalBusiness whose telephone and address come from data/system/locations.json; plus the four root files (404.html, favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon.png, site.webmanifest)
validators.why: Search Readiness a9, b1, b2, b6, c1, c2, c3 (3 Nov 2026). Without 404.html Cloudflare Pages answered 200 with the homepage for every unknown path, hiding broken links; titles ran to 139 characters; no inner page said which business it belonged to
